mission: Build the new Free Nova the Optimal AI as a complete dual-host generalist from current canonical sources.
acceptance: One Nova front door carries the current ambient MIND and exactly the settled Free capability loadout.
Codex and Claude distributions are assembled from pinned canonical sources without private developer runtime dependencies.
Package, routing, documentation, and independent verification evidence support a local release-candidate handoff.

allowed: Read maintained Nova and capability repositories.
Run local deterministic and bounded behavioral checks.
reserved: Git push, GitHub release, public publication, store upload, and external announcement require separate user authority.
authority.sensitive_material: Do not copy private developer paths, credentials, customer data, or Nova estate contents into the product.

admission_basis: Three initial bounded audits improved source, architecture, and acceptance coverage; the root recovered one interrupted architecture return, then separate Hesperos and TestForge roles supplied disjoint authoring/operator/reviewer evidence.

root.work: Mission custody, all product and build writes, recovery of the interrupted architecture branch, evidence reconciliation, final validation, and handoff.

workers.objective: Resolve the canonical source tree and current version or commit for every settled Free capability.
workers.deliverable: A 25-root source matrix with exact paths, versions, evidence limits, and conflicts.
evidence_required: Canonical file paths and repository state for every consequential source claim.
workers.return_condition: Return the matrix, unresolved custody conflicts, and any capability that cannot be safely assembled.

workers.objective: Map the smallest migration from Nova 2.1.3 to the current MIND and dual-host edition architecture.
workers.deliverable: A concrete target tree, reuse map, build-script changes, and migration risks.
evidence_required: Existing source and build paths supporting the recommendation.
workers.return_condition: Return the target architecture, precise reuse boundaries, and blockers.

workers.objective: Define the Free edition customer promise, routing collision probes, documentation journey, and release evidence gates.
workers.deliverable: A concise acceptance matrix and Hesperos/TestForge gate plan grounded in existing product records.
evidence_required: Exact governing files for each proposed gate.
workers.return_condition: Return acceptance criteria, collision cases, documentation requirements, and residual host evidence boundaries.

workers.objective: Independently review the repaired customer documentation, package parity, render provenance, and accessibility boundaries.
workers.deliverable: Current Hesperos independent-review receipts bound to checkpoint 06b89ea3 and the customer ZIP.
evidence_required: Exact source/package parity, render hashes and dimensions, visual reinspection, explicit untested boundaries.
workers.return_condition: Return verdict, material findings, residual conditions, evidence boundary, and touched state.

workers.objective: Run the repaired candidate through the TestForge operator cycle.
workers.deliverable: Fresh regression, package, documentation, site, risk, traceability, metered, and operator receipts.
evidence_required: Fresh captured execution results, canonical manifest and traceability validation, explicit not-run states.
workers.return_condition: Return operator decision, local qualification proposal, validator results, blockers, and metered disposition.

workers.objective: Challenge the stable TestForge packet, repaired lifecycle/workflow defects, artifact binding, and overclaim boundaries.
workers.deliverable: Independent reviewer verdict and focused adversarial, contract, binding, and validator receipts.
evidence_required: Independent artifact hashes, focused reruns, reviewer validation, explicit public and host boundaries.
workers.return_condition: Return bounded verdict, material findings, conditions, reopen triggers, and touched state.

budgets.model_policy: Use the inherited qualified route; keep architecture and final acceptance at the root.
budgets.stop_condition: Stop or re-plan when a worker needs the root's not-yet-settled product decision or any write surface.

merge.method: Root independently observed canonical state, recovered the interrupted architecture branch through a single writer, froze checkpoint 06b89ea3, reconciled fresh Hesperos and TestForge returns against exact archive hashes, and retained public rights and publication as separate gates.

next_move: Handoff the qualified local candidate. Before public distribution, obtain six component grants, reconcile two metadata sets, rebuild, and rerun package, Hesperos, TestForge, and separately authorized fresh-host acceptance.
